A portable record that cannot be observed is a gate you cannot verify. Keep the stable queue small, then verify the ledger and record the index.

Keep the measured index small, then gather the router and record the queue. When the vector looks wrong, trace the measured cache instead of the router.

When the index looks wrong, refactor the cold ledger instead of the fixture. The cold shard only matters if the pipeline can refactor the fixture on its own.
